QuestInfo.name: The Empress' Chief Knight
QuestInfo.0: The Empress has recovered her health. #bNeinheart#k is calling me. Let's go listen.
QuestInfo.1: I heard that the Empress is looking for me, let's go visit #bCygnus#k the Empress.
QuestInfo.2: You were appointed the new Chief of the Cygnus Knights. You have sworn in front of the Empress to stand on the front lines against the Black Mage, and to prepare for the dark day he awakens.
